title: Bastard!! Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A kingdom besieged by four generals seeking to revive the evil god Anthrasax unseals the ancient wizard Dark Schneider, sealed inside a 14-year-old boy and released by a virgin's kiss. The arrogant, lecherous sorcerer fights for his own reasons, and the story later escalates into a war between Heaven and Hell on Earth. A long-running heavy-metal fantasy, only partly released in English by Viz.
life_message: Raw power, swagger and appetite are celebrated, tempered only by the few bonds the hero actually keeps.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Dark Schneider answers every slight with overwhelming force (ANN).

Order vs freedom.evidence: The hero is a chaotic force who never reforms or submits (ANN).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty runs to Yoko and his former companions rather than to the kingdom.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Power ranks everyone; generals and gods form hierarchies.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Gods, angels and demons are real but given pseudo-scientific explanations (ANN).

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Survival war paired with flamboyant self-indulgence.

folkways.japan: Originated in Weekly Shonen Jump; its heavy-metal and Dungeons and Dragons borrowings reflect 1980s Japanese fandom of Western rock and tabletop games.

delivery.evidence: Reviewer calls it pure adrenaline with no real moral message beyond excess (ANN House of 1000 Manga).
delivery.note: The series argues for nothing directly; its celebration of a self-indulgent hero comes through spectacle and comedy.

winners_losers: Dark Schneider repeatedly prevails through sheer power; heaven and hell alike are shown as destructive, and sympathy rests with the defiant hero.
